sourceText: User asked: 赶紧修复，看看修复完之后，有没有数据进去，如果有数据进去，再考虑把历史数据放进去. The concrete complaint is that PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED is off after prior work, so new DONE stories do not automatically enter the learning settlement layer.
normalizedOutcome: A future story reaching DONE writes a non-authoritative done-settlement learning health row without a manual env var, while explicit opt-out still disables it and DONE success still does not count as helped evidence.
acceptanceClaim: With PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED unset, runPostDoneLearningSettlement records a done-settlement health row; playbook_promotion_status reports settlement default-on posture; after B-5e28 reaches DONE the live learning health log contains a B-5e28 done-settlement row.
